description: Returns Overflow drawings by id, up to 20 at a time, as SVG or JSX. Icons and isometric stills come back inline as markup. Illustrations and animated isometric drawings, which run to tens of kilobytes, come back as a download link that works for fifteen minutes, with a curl command that saves the file; the delivery option returns them inline instead. Free drawings need no key; the others need an Overflow Pro licence key sent with the connection. Each result ends with the licence terms.

animated.description: Isometric only: the moving version, a custom element with its own script, that moves under the pointer. Needs Pro.

delivery.description: auto: inline for icons and isometric stills, a link for the rest. Or inline, or link.

fill.description: Isometric only: colour (the site's default), plain (greys) or stroke (outline only).

format.description: svg, or jsx: the same markup with React attribute names, to paste into a component.

ids.description: Drawing ids, such as icon/calendar, illustration/office-club/teamwork or isometric/240/crate.

style.description: Icons and illustrations: regular, or duotone with a second, lighter tone.

theme.description: Isometric only: colours for a light page or a dark one.

name: get_drawings
title: Get Overflow drawings
